game_start.intro: Agyapadeɛ no hyɛ ase. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump kaa: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyɛ ɔgya {player_id} wɔ German Whist.
{phase_info}
Wɔwɔ {hand_size} kaa.
Di kaa a ɛwɔ '[play N]', a ɛyɛ ne dibea wɔ wo nsam (sɛ nhwɛso '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: No card is on offer - the playing phase has begun.
next_card.deck_empty: The deck is empty - no card is on offer.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ntotoe a enni mu. Fa '[play N]' di dwuma de adi nkrataa a ɛto so N wɔ wo nsam no ho dwuma.
invalid_move.bad_position: That card position does not exist. You hold {hand_size} cards.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Ɛsɛ sɛ wusuasua no na wode {lead_suit} kaade di dwuma.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Wontumi mfa saa kaade no nni dwuma.

trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} wins the trick with {card} and takes the face-up card.

phase.learning_complete: The deck is exhausted. The learning phase is over - every remaining trick counts towards victory.

draw.winner_received: Woadi nkonim wɔ agoru no mu na woanya {card}.
draw.loser_received: Woadi nkogu na woayi {card} afi ɔfasu no mu.
draw.winner_preview: Krataa a edi hɔ no yɛ {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Nkonim a ɛfiri hɔ - ɔgya 0: {tricks0}, ɔgya 1: {tricks1}
turn.scores_playing: Nkonim a ɛfiri hɔ - ɔgya 0: {tricks0}, ɔgya 1: {tricks1}

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Karta biara nni hɔ a wo nsa bɛka no.

trick_view.empty: Obiara nni hɔ a wadi nkrataa yi ho dwuma.
